SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — NOT PNW POLICY

Synthetic plan-of-study procedure

Steps for the 2030-2031 Synthetic Data Science, MS program

  1. Review the published program requirements and draft the proposed course list.
  2. Discuss the draft with the assigned academic advisor.
  3. Obtain the advisor's approval of the proposed plan.
  4. Submit the approved plan through the fictional Graduate Plan portal.

The procedure explains preparation and approval steps only. It does not select courses for a student, replace advisor review, or determine whether a personal plan is valid.
